note: Sendcloud remains the logistics platform. This generic selector contract does not prove the standard Sendcloud app can execute it, and does not authorize any additional app/subscription.

classification.source: Approved variant logistics.shipping_class, or unique SKU allowlist compiled from those approvals
classification.tableB: ALL physical cart variants are approved bulb or succulent
classification.tableA: ANY physical cart variant is ordinary, heavy, bulky, unknown, unapproved or not in the reduced allowlist

nativePriceRanges: Shopify TOTAL_PRICE conditions select applicable amount tiers. The app must not calculate a separate product-group subtotal.
actions: Hide every managed method outside the selected table and area.
Exactly one applicable managed method must remain after Shopify native price conditions.
Rename remaining method to approved buyer-facing shipping label.
Never change options for non-IT destinations.
Unapproved geography, unserviceable products/destinations or multiple groups must follow a separately verified blocking path.
acceptanceBeforeRelease: Demonstrate ALL/ANY predicates with approved and unknown items in the same cart.
Demonstrate exact CAP plus locality matching and complete exception list.
Verify product metafield or unique SKU lookup; ignore browser-supplied classification.
Export actual app rules, rule priority, identifier mapping, subscription limits and rollback behavior.
Demonstrate no interval exposing all 18 prices during activation and rollback.
Complete staging matrix and post-authorization native checkout smoke without payment.
